supersedes: The workload-termination portion of workstation-k3s-retirement-20261114.json was incomplete. Files, service, mounts and interfaces were checked, but independent container scopes survived.
cause: Kubernetes containers had independent systemd scopes. The upstream shim-process matcher and K3s service shutdown did not terminate them.
action: GUI-authenticated SIGKILL of only the 48 host cri-containerd container scopes. No Docker or QEMU scopes selected.
sourceCorrection: Retirement now removes and verifies systemd container scopes independently of its completion markers. Four regression tests cover orphan scopes, failed termination, repeat calls, and unrelated-scope rejection.
